readerCopy.headline: You may have more influence than you are used to.
readerCopy.body:
A long effort gets traction. Someone with access says yes. A change that once required a fight may now be possible because you have better information, stronger support, or more credibility than you had before. You may not need to push nearly as hard as you expected.

Jupiter trine Pluto is useful when you know what you want the influence for. Move the part that matters. Negotiate the better term. Remove the condition that has been draining the whole arrangement. Stop before useful leverage turns into control for its own sake.
doNotAssume: Do not assume a promotion, financial gain, political influence, or permanent power.
